name: Highway Treat
why_it_matters: The Mandi address that locals send you to for proper Pahari food — dham, sidu, madra, and Beas-river trout, served as a sit-down menu rather than the festival-only thali most other places only do during Shivratri. Front patio under trees, multi-cuisine sidebar for the kids who won't touch sidu.
insider_tip: Order the dham as a thali; the madra and rajma are the dishes Mandi-Kangra weddings serve and few restaurants do them right. If the trout is on, take it — it's caught in the Beas, not farmed.

name: Brindavan Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: Above the Axis Bank, opposite Indira Market — Mandi's go-to pure-veg sit-down. Ranks #4 of 14 restaurants on TripAdvisor (5.0 rating, small but consistent sample), 4.3 on Justdial across 394 reviews. Dosa-and-thali standard reliable enough that families come back the next day.
insider_tip: Take the staircase up — easy to miss from the Seri Bazaar street level. Open 10am-11pm so it works for a late lunch when everywhere else has closed the kitchen.
signature_address: 366/7, 1st Floor, above Axis Bank, opposite Indira Market, Seri Bazar, Samkhetar, Mandi 175001

name: The Treat Restaurant
why_it_matters: The dinner-out address inside Indira Market — where Mandi families book birthdays and anniversaries. Multi-cuisine spans North Indian, Chinese, Continental, Italian, South Indian. The same group runs Bake Hut bakery, so the pastry side is unusually strong for a Himachali small-town restaurant.
insider_tip: If you're staying nearby, order pastries from Bake Hut (same group) for breakfast and come back to Treat for dinner — it's the same kitchen-discipline run by people who actually train staff.

name: Cafe Alimentaire
why_it_matters: Mandi's strongest cafe in the modern sense — espresso, salads, pizza, decent music — tucked in School Bazar near Samkhetar. The address NIT Mandi students and remote-working out-of-towners default to when they want laptop-friendly seating that isn't a thali joint.
insider_tip: Don't expect Manali-tier coffee, but it's the only Mandi address that consistently runs an actual espresso machine. Salmon salad is genuinely worth ordering — unusual find at this price point in a hill town.

name: Raj Mahal Palace
why_it_matters: Mandi's only heritage-hotel restaurant — built as the Mandi royal family's residence under Raja Bhawani Sen, refurbished into a hotel in 1982 when the family moved out. The Carbo Prio dining room and bar/lounge keep the old-Mandi atmosphere; ranks among TripAdvisor's top-3 for Mandi.
insider_tip: The lounge is the underrated room — wood panelling, royal-portrait wall, the closest thing Mandi has to a cocktail bar. Walk in for a drink even if you're eating dinner elsewhere.
signature_address: Raj Mahal Palace Hotel, near District Court, Paddal, Mandi 175001

name: Chawla's 2
why_it_matters: A Mandi-Manali highway institution since 1960 — one of the oldest sit-down restaurants between Chandigarh and Manali, Beas-bank seating, family-run. The kind of place every road-tripper from Delhi has stopped at without realising it's the same kitchen running for 60+ years.
insider_tip: Order cream chicken — their house dish, milk-cream-pepper-cardamom, not the standard butter-chicken-with-cream the rest of north India serves. Drivers eat free; locals know to ask for the riverside table outside.
signature_address: 5km from Mandi Bus Stand towards Manali, Shila Kippar, Purani Mandi 175001

name: Moti Mahal Delux
why_it_matters: Mandi outpost of the Daryaganj Moti Mahal lineage — the family that's claimed credit for inventing butter chicken and dal makhani in Delhi in the 1940s. Khaliar location (near the petrol pump on the highway) makes it a reliable break for Manali-bound traffic that wants the original recipe rather than a hill-town variation.
insider_tip: It's not the original Daryaganj kitchen but it's run under the licensed brand; the butter chicken cooks the same way. Pair with garlic naan, not regular — the naan dough at this branch is consistently good.
signature_address: Kunal's Complex, near Petrol Pump, Khaliar, Mandi 175001
